Bug_Title: Nm: Class defines hashcode(); should it be hashCode()? (NM_LCASE_HASHCODE)
Bug_Details:
This class defines a method called hashcode().  This method
does not override the hashCode() method in java.lang.Object,
which is probably what was intended. hashcode() hashCode() java.lang.Object
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by defining a method named 'hashcode()' instead of 'hashCode()'. This method does not override the 'hashCode()' method in java.lang.Object, which is probably what was intended. This causes issues when the object is used in collections that rely on hashing, such as HashMap.
